notice: Illustrative sample catalogue: supplier names, prices and posts are demonstration content, not live marketplace listings.

provenance.malls.json: Public South African shopping-centre directory (names, suburbs, metros, coordinates). Tenant lists and unit counts are indicative.
provenance.merchants.json: Hand-authored sample suppliers. Verification status, CIPC registrations, ratings and review counts were removed because they were never observed.
provenance.products.json: Hand-authored sample catalogue rows with representative prices and Unsplash photography. Brand and model names are used descriptively.
provenance.deals.json: Hand-authored sample circulars. Branch counts, stock levels and locker rates were removed because they were invented.
provenance.posts.json: Hand-authored sample trade-wire posts. Authorship is fictional; engagement counts and verification were removed.
provenance.shorts.json: Sample 9:16 placeholders using a public Google demo video and Unsplash stills. View and like counts were removed.
provenance.trends.json: Sample trend labels. Post counts were removed because they were invented.
provenance.guilds.json: Sample community groups. Member and post counts were removed because they were invented.

contactNumbers: All phone and WhatsApp numbers in this catalogue are synthetic placeholders generated for the demo. They must not be replaced with real subscriber numbers without the business's consent.
imagery: Product and cover imagery points at Unsplash CDN URLs for demonstration only and is not licensed for production use.
